purpose: Independent mathematical accuracy gate for the Rust ERF series; distinct from the frozen GGML/UCRT raw-output parity gate, which remains separate.
inputs: All nonnegative finite F16 and BF16 values mapped through source F32 x/sqrt(2), when the argument is <=4; a uniform 1/4096 grid on [0,4]; all powers of two; adjacent F32 boundary values. Rust tests also check every negative argument through odd symmetry.
expected: 80-digit mpmath erf rounded to binary32 by explicit nearest-candidate distance and ties-to-even, plus a binary64 reference. No Rust output is used.
